title: Chitosan-enclosed SLN improved SV-induced hepatocellular cell carcinoma death by modulation of IQGAP gene expression, JNK, and HDAC activities.
authors: Harisa, Gamaleldin I; Bakheit, Ahmed H; Alshehri, Samiyah; Attia, Sabry M; Attia, Mohamed S M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究壳聚糖包被辛伐他汀固体脂质纳米粒对肝癌细胞死亡的影响及IQGAP/JNK/HDAC调控，仅含MOE分子对接且非蛋白-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a global life-threatening problem and therapeutic interventions are still encountered. IQGAP genes are involved in HCC oncogenesis. The modulatory effect of statins on the expression of IQGAP genes is still unclear. This study aims to study the effect of free SV and chitosan (CS) decorated simvastatin (SV) loaded solid lipid nanoparticles (C-SV-SLNs) on HCC mortality. METHODS AND RESULTS: Plain, SV-SLN, and C-SV- SLN were prepared and characterized in terms of particle size (PS), zeta potential (ZP), and polydispersity index (PDI). The biosafety of different SLN was investigated using fresh erythrocytes, moreover, cytotoxicity was investigated using HepG2 cell lines. The effect of SLNs on IQGAPs gene expression as well as JNK, HDAC6, and HDAC8 activity was investigated using PCR and MOE-docking. The current results displayed that SV-SLNs have nanosized, negative ZP and are homogenous, CS decoration shifts the ZP of SLN into cationic ZP. Furthermore, all SLNs exhibited desirable biosafety in terms of no deleterious effect on erythrocyte integrity. SV solution and SV-SLN significantly increase the mortality of HepG2 compared to undertreated cells, however, the effect of SV-SLN is more pronounced compared to free SV. Remarkably, C-SV-SLN elicits high HepG2 cell mortality compared to free SV and SV-SLN. The treatment of HepG2 cells with SV solution, SV-SLN, or C-SV-SLN significantly upregulates the IQGAP2 gene with repression of IQGAP1 and IQGAP3 genes. MOE-docking studies revealed both SV and tenivastatin exhibit interactions with the active sites of JNK, HDAC6, and HDAC8. Moreover, tenivastatin exhibited greater interactions with magnesium and zinc compared to SV. CONCLUSIONS: This research provides novel insights into the therapeutic potential of SV, SV-SLN and C-SV-SLNs in HCC treatment, modulating critical signaling cascades involving IQGAPs, JNK, and HDAC. The development of C-SV-SLNs presents a promising strategy for effective HCC therapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（HCC）是一个全球性的生命威胁问题，治疗干预措施仍面临挑战。IQGAP基因参与HCC的肿瘤发生。他汀类药物对IQGAP基因表达的调节作用尚不清楚。本研究旨在探讨游离辛伐他汀（SV）及壳聚糖（CS）修饰的辛伐他汀负载固体脂质纳米粒（C-SV-SLNs）对HCC死亡率的影响。方法与结果：制备了普通、SV-SLN和C-SV-SLN，并对其粒径（PS）、zeta电位（ZP）和多分散指数（PDI）进行了表征。使用新鲜红细胞研究不同SLN的生物安全性，同时使用HepG2细胞系研究细胞毒性。通过PCR和MOE-对接研究了SLNs对IQGAPs基因表达以及JNK、HDAC6和HDAC8活性的影响。当前结果显示，SV-SLNs具有纳米尺寸、负ZP且均一，CS修饰将SLN的ZP转变为阳离子ZP。此外，所有SLNs均表现出良好的生物安全性，对红细胞完整性无有害影响。与未处理细胞相比，SV溶液和SV-SLN显著增加HepG2的死亡率，然而，SV-SLN的效果比游离SV更为显著。值得注意的是，与游离SV和SV-SLN相比，C-SV-SLN诱导了更高的HepG2细胞死亡率。用SV溶液、SV-SLN或C-SV-SLN处理HepG2细胞显著上调IQGAP2基因，同时抑制IQGAP1和IQGAP3基因。MOE-对接研究表明，SV和替尼伐他汀均与JNK、HDAC6和HDAC8的活性位点发生相互作用。此外，与SV相比，替尼伐他汀与镁和锌的相互作用更强。结论：本研究为SV、SV-SLN和C-SV-SLNs在HCC治疗中的治疗潜力提供了新见解，调节涉及IQGAPs、JNK和HDAC的关键信号级联。C-SV-SLNs的开发为有效HCC治疗提供了一种有前景的策略。
